question: Which of the following sectors includes all the business entities, corporations, and partnerships?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Firms sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Firms sector** comprises all **business entities, corporations, and partnerships** engaged in producing goods and services for profit.
 
• This sector is a critical component of the **economic system**, as it drives production, employment, and economic growth.
